verdict.rationale: Skill SKILL.md files carry descriptions that say what the skill does and when to use it. Examples: tdd says "Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first", grilling says "Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking", and setup says "Run once before first use". The aihero.dev catalog gives a one-line purpose for each listed skill, skills are invoked via slash commands, and a runtime probe confirmed installed SKILL.md frontmatter reads back cleanly. Missing for 10: evidence that every one of the 25–27 skills documents its activation triggers (only a few are shown), any explicit guidance on auto-activation versus manual invocation behavior, and independent corroboration that the descriptions make behavior predictable.

support.subject: As a developer, every skill documents what it does and when it activates, so I can predict my agent's new behavior before it surprises me

citations.quote: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.
Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking
Run once before first use of the other engineering skills.
Install the ones you want, then type a slash command.
Find out which skill to use for the situation you are in.
